name: Scheduliyo
author: scheduliyo

sections.description:
Scheduliyo adds online appointment booking to your WordPress site. Customers choose a service, a staff member, a date and a time, and book in a few steps. You manage everything from one admin area in WordPress.

Features

  • Booking widget – add it to any page or post with the [scheduliyo_booking] shortcode or the Scheduliyo Booking block.
  • Manage-booking page – the [scheduliyo_manage_booking] shortcode gives customers a page where they can cancel or reschedule a booking from the secure link they receive.
  • Bookings – create, edit, reschedule and cancel bookings from the admin area.
  • Calendar and dashboard – see your upcoming bookings at a glance.
  • Services – set a name, duration and price for each service.
  • Staff – set working hours, breaks and time off for the staff members who deliver your services. Approved time off keeps those days from being booked.
  • Location – store your business address and place it on a map.
  • Customers – keep a record of every customer and their bookings. Customers are unlimited.
  • Email notifications – booking emails are sent through WordPress’s own mail or through your own SMTP server. Automatic reminders go out a chosen number of hours before each confirmed appointment (Settings → Booking → Booking Reminders, where a ready-made reminder email can be created in one click), and you can also send a reminder by hand from a booking.
  • Offline payments – record payments taken in person, such as cash at the appointment.
  • Change history – changes to bookings and locations are recorded and shown on each booking and location. A new site keeps a year of history and removes older entries automatically; Settings → System → Audit History changes or turns this off.
  • Setup wizard – a guided first-run setup for your business details, working hours, services and staff.
  • Translation ready – all text uses the scheduliyo text domain.

No limits

The free plugin is fully functional. Add as many services, staff members, locations, customers and bookings as you need.

Scheduliyo Pro

Scheduliyo Pro is a separate plugin, available from scheduliyo.com. It adds further features, such as online payments and SMS notifications. The free plugin does not need Pro and never asks for a license key.

External services

Scheduliyo works on your own server. It contacts the outside services below only in the situations described. No API key or account is needed for any of them, except an SMTP server of your own if you choose to send email through one.

OpenStreetMap Nominatim (address search)

  • What it is used for: finding a location’s address and coordinates when you set or edit your business location.
  • When: only when an administrator, on the location map, presses Search (or Enter) for an address, clicks the map, drags the pin, or uses Use my location. Nothing is searched while you type. The map is offered in two places: the Address tab of a location in Settings → Locations, and the Setup Wizard‘s Business Details step, after Find on map is pressed. The request is made by your server, not your browser.
  • What is sent: the address text you searched for, or the coordinates of the pin, plus a user agent that names the plugin (Scheduliyo and its version) and your site’s address, as Nominatim’s usage policy requires.
  • How often: answers are kept on your site for a day, so repeating a search sends nothing. Your site sends at most one request a second, shared by every administrator; a lookup made sooner is refused with “The address lookup is busy” and nothing is sent.
  • Enabled by: an administrator using the map as described; nothing is sent otherwise.
  • Turning it off: add add_filter( 'scheduliyo/geocoder/enabled', '__return_false' ); to your site (for example in a small must-use plugin). Your site then never contacts Nominatim, not even to reuse a saved answer. The map’s search box is hidden; you can still place the pin by hand and type the address. This setting is per site and lives in your site’s code: neither Scheduliyo nor OpenStreetMap can switch it remotely. It does not affect the map tiles below.
  • Usage Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
  • Privacy Policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy

OpenStreetMap map tiles

  • What it is used for: showing the location map, in Settings → Locations and on the Setup Wizard‘s Business Details step.
  • When: only while an administrator has that map on screen: on the Address tab of a location in Settings → Locations, or after Find on map is pressed in the Setup Wizard. Only the map area on screen is loaded; nothing is downloaded in advance. The map images are loaded by the administrator’s browser, directly from OpenStreetMap.
  • What is sent: the administrator’s IP address, browser user agent, your site’s address (as the referrer, which the tile policy asks browsers to send) and the map area being viewed.
  • Enabled by: opening the location map in either place; nothing is loaded otherwise.
  • Tile Usage Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
  • Privacy Policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy

Your SMTP server (optional)

If you enter SMTP settings, booking emails are delivered through the mail server you choose. Scheduliyo signs in to that server with the username and password you entered, and the server receives each email and its recipient, as it would for any mail. Its terms and privacy policy are those of your email provider.

Amazon S3 and S3-compatible storage (moving earlier images back)

Scheduliyo stores every image you upload in your own site’s uploads folder (wp-content/uploads/scheduleos/images) and does not upload images to S3. An early version could store images in an S3 bucket instead, so a site that used it may still hold image addresses that point there. The only thing Scheduliyo does with them is copy those images back.

  • What it is used for: downloading images whose stored address still points at S3 and saving them in your WordPress media library, so that your site no longer depends on the bucket.
  • When: only when an administrator presses Migrate S3 Images to Local Media on the Image Storage settings card (Settings → Advanced). The requests are made by your server.
  • What is sent: one ordinary download request for each such image, to the address stored for it: an Amazon S3 address (amazonaws.com) or the address of an S3-compatible storage host (one containing s3.). No access key, secret key or other credential is sent, and no booking or customer details. Like any request WordPress makes, it carries WordPress’s standard user agent, which includes your site’s address.
  • Enabled by: an administrator starting the migration; nothing is sent otherwise, and a site with no such image addresses contacts nothing.
  • Amazon S3 Terms of Service: https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms/
  • Amazon Privacy Policy: https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/
  • For another S3-compatible host, the terms and privacy policy are those of that storage provider.

Links a person chooses to open

Scheduliyo sends nothing to these services itself. They are ordinary links, and information reaches the service only if the person clicks the link.

  • Google Calendar and Outlook.com: the booking confirmation offers “Add to Calendar” links. Clicking one sends the booking’s service name, date, time and location to that calendar service.
  • Google Maps: a location can offer a directions link. Clicking it sends the branch’s address to Google Maps.
  • WhatsApp: a customer with a referral code can share it. Clicking the link sends the referral message to WhatsApp.
  • scheduliyo.com: links in the admin area, and the “Powered by” link if you turn it on, open the plugin’s website.
  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Microsoft Services Agreement: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
  • WhatsApp Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • WhatsApp Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

Source code

Every file in Scheduliyo is either readable as shipped or built from readable source that is included in this plugin. Nothing is obfuscated.

  • Admin app: assets/dist/admin/ is compiled with Vite from the Vue and TypeScript source in resources/admin/.
  • Booking widget stylesheet: resources/public/styles/booking-widget.min.css is built from the parts in resources/styles-src/booking-widget/, which are joined into resources/public/styles/booking-widget.css and then minified.
  • Booking widget and Manage Booking scripts: resources/public/booking-widget.js and resources/public/manage-booking.js ship as written and are not compiled.
  • PHP: everything under src/ ships as written.

To rebuild the compiled files, run these two commands in the plugin folder (Node.js 18 or later):

npm install
npm run build

The build files (package.json, package-lock.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js and the build/ folder) are included in the plugin.

Third-party libraries served as shipped, in minified form, with their public source:

  • Alpine.js 3.15.8 (assets/vendor/alpinejs/, MIT): https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine
  • Lucide 0.575.0 (assets/vendor/lucide/, ISC): https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Libraries bundled into the admin app by the build above, at the versions pinned in package-lock.json: Vue 3.5.29, Vue Router 4.6.4, Pinia 2.3.1, FullCalendar 6.1.20 (with Preact 10.12.1), FullCalendar Premium 6.1.20, Chart.js 4.5.1 (with @kurkle/color 0.3.4), vue-chartjs 5.3.3, Leaflet 1.9.4, Cropper.js 1.6.2, jsQR 1.4.0, lucide-vue-next 0.575.0, Simple Icons 16.23.0 and Tailwind CSS 3.4.19. PHP libraries in vendor/: Action Scheduler 4.2.0, chillerlan/php-qrcode 6.0.1 and chillerlan/php-settings-container 3.3.0. The LICENSE file lists each one with its licence and source.

License

Scheduliyo is free software, released under the GNU General Public License version 2 or (at your option) any later version. See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html.

It includes third-party libraries under GPL-compatible licences (MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, Apache-2.0, CC0-1.0 and GPLv3), listed with their sources in the LICENSE file. Two of them are used under GPLv3: Action Scheduler, and FullCalendar Premium under its GPLv3 option. Scheduliyo’s “version 2 or any later version” includes version 3, so the plugin as distributed may be used and redistributed under GPLv3.

The web fonts the plugin uses are bundled with it and served from your own site: Inter, IBM Plex Mono, Newsreader, Space Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Roboto, Open Sans, Poppins, Outfit, Lora, Playfair Display, Bricolage Grotesque and Space Mono. Each is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the licence and copyright notice for each family are in assets/fonts.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Scheduliyo”, then click Install Now and Activate. (Or upload the scheduliyo folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it on the Plugins screen.)
  2. Open Scheduliyo in the admin menu and follow the setup wizard to enter your business details, working hours, services and staff.
  3. Add the booking widget to a page with the [scheduliyo_booking] shortcode or the Scheduliyo Booking block, then publish the page.
  4. To let customers cancel or reschedule, add the [scheduliyo_manage_booking] shortcode to a page.

Scheduliyo requires PHP 8.2 or newer and WordPress 6.5 or newer.
sections.faq:
Is the free version limited?

No. There is no limit on services, staff members, locations, customers or bookings. Scheduliyo Pro is a separate plugin with further features; the free plugin does not need it.

Do my staff members need a login?

No. Scheduliyo is run by your site’s administrators. A staff member is a booking record — working hours, services and location — and can be booked without a WordPress account. The free plugin does not create logins for staff. A WordPress user you give one of Scheduliyo’s roles (Users → Edit) can use the screens that role allows. Inviting staff, custom roles and per-role seats are part of Scheduliyo Pro.

Do I need an account or a license key?

No. The free plugin works on its own and does not connect to any Scheduliyo account or license server.

How are booking emails sent?

Through WordPress’s own mail function by default. You can enter your own SMTP server in the settings instead.

Can customers pay online?

Online payments are part of Scheduliyo Pro. The free plugin lets you record offline payments, such as cash taken at the appointment.

Does Scheduliyo contact other websites?

Only in the situations listed under External services below. If you set up your own SMTP server, it delivers your booking emails. The other services receive no booking or customer details.
